question: Choose the word that is the antonym of Giant.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Tiny**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Giant"** refers to something that is extremely large or massive in size. (विशाल)
 
 
• **Example:** The statue of liberty is a giant structure that attracts millions of visitors every year.
 
 
• **"Tiny"** is the antonym of "Giant" and refers to something that is very small or minute in size. (छोटा)
 
 
• **Example:** The baby held a tiny flower in her hands, which was barely visible.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"Giant"** is **"Tiny"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Tiny**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Huge** (विशाल): Refers to something very large in size or amount.
 
 
• **Example:** The huge mountain range stretched as far as the eye could see.
 
 
 
• **Immense** (अत्यधिक): Refers to something extremely large or vast.
 
 
• **Example:** The immense ocean was a breathtaking sight.
 
 
 
• **Enormous** (बहुत बड़ा): Refers to something extraordinarily large in size or extent.
 
 
• **Example:** The enormous elephant towered over all the other animals in the jungle.
